question.text: Nitration of aniline in strong acidic medium also gives m-nitroaniline because

options.text: In absence of substituents nitro group always goes to m-position.
In electrophilic substitution reactions amino group is meta directive.
Inspite of substituents nitro group always goes to only m-position.
In acidic (strong) medium aniline is present as anilinium ion.

solution.text: As -NH3⊕      is m-directing and strongly ring deactivating, hence besides para (51%) and ortho (2%), meta product (47%) is also formed in significant yield here.
